newsitem.title: GREECE: Makeshift bomb damages Citibank branch in Athens.
newsitem.headline: Makeshift bomb damages Citibank branch in Athens.

text.p: A makeshift bomb of camping gas canisters damaged a branch office of U.S. bank Citibank in Athens on Thursday, but no one was injured, police said.
The attack was claimed by the leftist "Revolutionary Nuclei" group in a telephone call to an Athens television station. The group has carried out similar attacks in the past.
"It was a small bomb which caused a fire outside the bank. There was some damage but no inluries," a police official said.
Another Athens Citibank branch was damaged in a bomb blast a week ago but no one has claimed responsibility for that attack.
Police said the two attacks were probably unconnected.
